blocks.title: Network protocol
blocks.text: Network protocol baat-cheet ke qawaid ka majmua hai. Yeh tay karta hai ke data kis format mein aur kaise bheja jaye, aur ghaltiyon ke intizam aur delivery ko control karta hai. Network ke tamam devices ko aik hi protocol par chalna hota hai.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: Protocols un zabanon ki tarah hain jin mein computers aapas mein baat karte hain.

blocks.caption: Aam protocols aur services
rows: Internet ka bunyadi protocol majmua, taqreeban har network mein. TCP qabil-e-aitbaar delivery; IP addressing aur routing.
Web browser aur web server ke darmiyan web pages muntaqil karta hai. Data encrypt nahi karta.
HTTP ka mehfooz version: SSL/TLS encryption browser aur server ke darmiyan passwords, zaati maloomat aur payment data bachata hai.
Files upload aur download karta, bari files bhi; web developers use karte hain. Mehfooz versions bhi hain.
Website ke naam ko IP address mein badalta hai, taake users ko numbers yaad na rakhne paren. DNS servers yeh tarjuma karte hain.

blocks.alt: Baen 'your browser' computer jis ke oopar www.example.com; darmiyan DNS server; daen web server. Browser se DNS server tak neela teer: 1 www.example.com ka IP kya hai? Wapas sabz teer: 2 yeh 93.184.216.34 hai. Browser se web server tak narangi kham-dar teer: 3 browser 93.184.216.34 se jur kar page load karta.
blocks.caption: DNS name resolution (Fig 1.14 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Log naam yaad rakhte hain, lekin computers aik doosre ko IP address se dhoondte hain. DNS naam ka number dhoondta hai, aur tab hi browser web server se rabta karta hai.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: Har dafa website kholne par DNS parde ke peeche kaam karta hai.

blocks.prompt: Web pages dekhne ke liye kaun sa protocol use hota hai, aur mehfooz websites is ke bajaye HTTPS kyun use karti hain?
blocks.explanation: HTTP. Yeh data be-encryption bhejta hai, is liye mehfooz websites HTTPS use karti hain jo SSL/TLS se data encrypt karta hai taake passwords aur payment ki tafseelat asani se churai na ja sakein.
Domain names (jaise www.example.com) ko un IP addresses mein badalna jin se computers aik doosre ko dhoondte hain.

items: Protocol: data ke format aur bhejne ke mushtarka qawaid.
TCP/IP: qabil-e-aitbaar delivery aur addressing aur routing.
HTTP/HTTPS: web pages (HTTPS SSL/TLS se encrypted); FTP: files; DNS: naam se IP address.
